description: Finds the AEMET weather station closest to the requested location and returns its most recent reading (temperature, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure). Useful for 'what's the weather right now' style questions.

location.description: Where to observe. Accepts a Spanish municipality name ('Madrid'), 5-digit INE code ('28079'), or a decimal coordinate pair ('40.4168,-3.7038').

name: get_nearest_observation
title: Latest real-time observation from the nearest AEMET weather station
